method.position: signal-weighted centroid of distinct GPS fixes (5 decimal places) where the phone was served by the cell; weight = 10^((dBm+130)/20)
method.accuracy_m: >=5 distinct points: max(300, 1.5 x p90 spread) [high]; 2-4: max(750, 2 x p90) [medium]; 1: 1500 [low]
method.cid16: low 16 bits of the 28-bit LTE ECI; Skytron devices report LAC/TAC and this value in hex in PVT packets

blacklist.reason: BSNL phone reported this cell for 3 h over a 9 km drive on 2026-10-31 while its dBm kept changing: a frozen identity. The CID (0xD4A6715) is an Airtel cell in TAC 7130 (Airtel devices report 6715/1BDA as a neighbour).
